messages:
Sam (Support): Heads-up — got two separate customer asks that look like the same feature request: CR-12345 (from Acme) and CR-12378 (from BetaCorp). Both ask for per-tenant latency budget controls.
Eva (PM): thanks Sam. Can you paste links to both threads and a one-liner on differences?
Sam (Support): Links: https://intake.company/CR-12345 and https://intake.company/CR-12378. One-liner: both want tenant-level latency caps, BetaCorp additionally asked for rollout flags.
Jordan (Sales): If we merge, both customers need a tailored update. BetaCorp’s rollout flag ask matters for their timeline — FYI.
Lucy (Triage): Suggest we make CR-12345 canonical (earlier submit) and merge 12378 into it, but keep BetaCorp’s rollout detail as a subtask/requirement.
Eva (PM): Agreed. Priority: P2 for canonical work, escalate rollout flag as P1 for BetaCorp if customer willing to pay for expedited engineering scope.
Sam (Support): Happy to message both customers. What’s the standard merge wording we should use?
Eva (PM): Use this short template: "We consolidated duplicate requests into a single ticket to streamline prioritization. Your specific rollout flag need is captured as a sub-requirement (CR-12345-sub2). We'll update you on scheduling once scoped."
Jordan (Sales): Please cc me on BetaCorp update. I’ll confirm if they want paid acceleration. @Sam can you add me?
Sam (Support): Sure — will cc @Jordan.
Lucy (Triage): Operationally: tagging plan -> add tags: customer-ask, duplicate-merged, canonical:CR-12345, priority:P2. For BetaCorp subtask add tag: customer-ask:rollout-flag, priority:P1-esc.
Eva (PM): Owner? Recommend assign to Mike (eng PM) for initial scoping + a separate owner for the paid rollout lane.
Sam (Support): Created comment on both intake pages and queued merge.
TriageBot: /intake merge 12378 into 12345 --keep-comments --notify=off
Lucy (Triage): If the bot can do it, please run with notify=off and we'll send curated emails manually.
TriageBot: merged CR-12378 -> CR-12345 (timestamp 1870004475). New subtask CR-12345-sub2 created for BetaCorp rollout detail.
Eva (PM): Thanks. Action items: 1) Eva to scope with Mike (due EOD Tue). 2) Sam to notify both customers with template and cc Jordan (today). 3) Lucy to apply tags and update roadmap tracker (today).
Jordan (Sales): Noted — will confirm BetaCorp acceleration decision by tomorrow.
Sam (Support): Message sent to both customers, quoted template, cc @Jordan — awaiting replies. :thumbsup:
Lucy (Triage): Tags added: customer-ask, duplicate-merged, canonical:CR-12345, priority:P2; subtask tags: customer-ask, rollout-flag, priority:P1-esc.
Eva (PM): Final note: let's track duplicates ratio next quarter. Create a quick filter in intake to surface potential duplicates by matching the top 5 keywords + tenant_name heuristics. Lucy, can you file a small follow-up ticket to improve dedupe suggestions?
Lucy (Triage): Will do — filing CR-1870004599: "Intake: improve fuzzy-duplicate suggestions (tenant, keywords)".
Sam (Support): Closing loop here once BetaCorp confirms. Thanks all.
Jordan (Sales): Thanks — good sync. :raised_hands:
